title: Kitab al-Umm
author: al-shafii
attributionNote: The attribution is the one the manuscript tradition and the scholarship give.
description: Al-Shafi'i's compendium of substantive law, arranged by topic, with the disagreements of earlier jurists recorded as he answers them. It is the earliest surviving systematic fiqh text of its size.
historicalContext: The recension preserved by al-Shafi'i's student al-Rabi' ibn Sulayman. It records the legal reasoning of the formative Shafi'i school and became a primary reference for later Shafi'i authorities.
availabilityNote: Arabic text only, streamed from OpenITI at read time. No English translation is included because no public-domain English translation was verified. Only the catalogue record, chapter outline and passage index are held here.
